name: callout
description: Callout band: icon + heading + text in a tinted box that sits in the band column. A composition; its behavioural sibling text/alert is a BLOCK because it has dismiss/variant logic.
provenPattern: A pure arrangement with no state or behaviour of its own, so it is a composition rather than a block (arrangement-only → template).

knowledge.purpose: Callout box of icon, heading and text — draws attention inside the flow, aligned with the bands around it
useCases: Giving a warning or a tip inside a section
Stating the precondition of a step
antiPatterns: Using it for a dismissible/stateful alert — that is the text/alert block's job
Several callouts in one section — when all are emphasised, none is
Picking an icon unrelated to the text
Nesting it inside another band or a card — it is a band of its own; inside a card use the text/alert block
Writing the heading as plain bold text — a reader of the page outline (a screen reader jumping by heading) skips the callout

mobileCollapse: The icon stays beside the heading at every width; the box fills the band column and the text wraps under the heading.

placeholders.{{ICON}}: icon.name — from the icon dictionary, matching what the text says (e.g. "package", "lock")
placeholders.{{TITLE}}: heading.text — the one-line heading of the callout (an h2 in the page outline, drawn at body-large size)

{{ACTION_LABEL}}.description: button.label of the one thing the reader can do about it, e.g. Find the help desk; "" for none

{{ACTION_HREF}}.description: where that action goes — an app route or an in-page anchor (/venue#helpdesk). "" draws no button (the button shows only when this is given)

{{ACTION_ICON}}.description: button.icon — from the icon dictionary, e.g. map-pin; "" for none
